#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
long long comb[777][777];
int rows, cols;
long long total;
long long best_val = (long long) 1e18, best_z = -1;
void dfs(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
    long long diff = abs(x - y);
    if (best_val <= 1 || diff - comb[v1][rows] * comb[v2][rows] >= best_val) return;
    if (v1 == rows - 1 && v2 == rows - 1) {
        long long diff = abs(x - y);
        if (diff < best_val) { best_val = diff; best_z = x; }
        return;
    }
    if (v1 >= rows) {
        long long cur1 = comb[v1][rows] - comb[v1 - 1][rows];
        long long sum2 = comb[v2][rows];
        dfs(x, y + cur1 * sum2, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (v2 >= rows) {
        long long sum1 = comb[v1][rows];
        long long cur2 = comb[v2][rows] - comb[v2 - 1][rows];
        dfs(x + sum1 * cur2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
}
char str[12345];
int cntA[12345], cntB[12345];
unordered_map<long long, long long> memo;
long long solve(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
    long long state = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
    auto it = memo.find(state);
    if (it != memo.end()) return it->second;
    long long &res = memo[state];
    long long diff = abs(x - y);
    if (diff - comb[v1][rows] * comb[v2][rows] > best_val) return res = 0;
    if (v1 < rows || v2 < rows) {
        if (v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] && v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]) {
            int sum = v1 + v2;
            v1 -= cntA[sum];
            v2 -= cntB[sum];
            return res = comb[v1 + v2][v1];
        }
        return res = 0;
    }
    res = 0;
    char c = str[v1 + v2 - 1];
    if (c != 'B') {
        long long cur1 = comb[v1][rows] - comb[v1 - 1][rows];
        long long sum2 = comb[v2][rows];
        res += solve(x, y + cur1 * sum2, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (c != 'A') {
        long long sum1 = comb[v1][rows];
        long long cur2 = comb[v2][rows] - comb[v2 - 1][rows];
        res += solve(x + sum1 * cur2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
    return res;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d %d", &rows, &cols);
    for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (rows + cols); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= 2 * (rows + cols); j++) {
            if (j == 0) comb[i][j] = 1;
            else if (i == 0) comb[i][j] = 0;
            else comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j] + comb[i - 1][j - 1];
        }
    }
    total = comb[rows + cols][rows] * comb[rows + cols][rows];
    {
        long long x = 0, y = 0;
        int v1 = rows + cols, v2 = rows + cols;
        while (v1 >= rows && v2 >= rows) {
            if (x > y) {
                long long cur1 = comb[v1][rows] - comb[v1 - 1][rows];
                long long sum2 = comb[v2][rows];
                y += cur1 * sum2;
                v1--;
            } else {
                long long sum1 = comb[v1][rows];
                long long cur2 = comb[v2][rows] - comb[v2 - 1][rows];
                x += sum1 * cur2;
                v2--;
            }
        }
        best_val = abs(x - y);
    }

        cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (str[i] == 'A');
        cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (str[i] == 'B');
    }
    long long ans = solve(0, 0, rows + cols, rows + cols);
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
